# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

    return -float(node.id)

    return out

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def affinity_to(pod_id: int, node_id: int, state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx) -> float:
    s = 0.0
    m = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        a = graph.src[e]
        b = graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if a == pod_id:
            other = b
        if b == pod_id:
            other = a
        if other >= 0 and other != pod_id:
            if state.pods[other].current_node == node_id:
                s += graph.rate[e]
    return s


def node_power(node: NodeState, cpu_alloc: int) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return 0.0
    if cpu_alloc <= 0:
        return 0.0
    util = float(cpu_alloc) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    return node.power_idle_w + (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * util


def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_ok = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request <= node.cpu_capacity
    mem_ok = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request <= node.mem_capacity
    if not cpu_ok:
        return -1000000.0
    if not mem_ok:
        return -1000000.0

    total_lat = 0.0
    on_node = 0
    m = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = ctx.graph.src[e]
        d = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod.id:
            other = d
        if d == pod.id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                total_lat += ctx.graph.rate[e] * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                if neighbor.current_node == node.id:
                    on_node += 1

    others = 0
    np = len(ctx.pods)
    for i in range(np):
        p = ctx.pods[i]
        if p.current_node == node.id and p.id != pod.id:
            others += 1

    after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    util = float(after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    power_after = node.power_idle_w + (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * util

    active = 0.0
    if node.cpu_allocated > 0:
        active = 1.0

    threshold = node.cpu_capacity * 9 // 10
    over_pen = 0.0
    if after > threshold:
        over_pen = float(after - threshold) * 200.0

    pack_bonus = float(others) * 60.0
    affinity_bonus = float(on_node) * 70.0
    active_bonus = active * 150.0
    power_pen = power_after * 0.6

    cost = total_lat - pack_bonus - affinity_bonus - active_bonus + over_pen + power_pen
    return -cost


def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    n_nodes = len(state.nodes)
    np = len(state.pods)
    cpu_now: list[int] = []
    mem_now: list[int] = []
    for j in range(n_nodes):
        cpu_now.append(state.nodes[j].cpu_allocated)
        mem_now.append(state.nodes[j].mem_allocated)
    for i in range(np):
        pod = state.pods[i]
        placed = pod.current_node >= 0
        movable = placed and (not pod.stateful) and (not pod.has_pdb)
        if movable and len(out) < budget:
            src_id = pod.current_node
            src_aff = affinity_to(pod.id, src_id, state, graph)
            src_cpu_before = cpu_now[src_id]
            src_cpu_after = src_cpu_before - pod.cpu_request
            src_power_before = node_power(state.nodes[src_id], src_cpu_before)
            src_power_after = node_power(state.nodes[src_id], src_cpu_after)
            src_reduction = src_power_before - src_power_after
            best = -1
            best_gain = 0.0
            for j in range(n_nodes):
                cand = state.nodes[j]
                distinct = j != src_id
                cpu_ok = cpu_now[j] + pod.cpu_request <= cand.cpu_capacity
                mem_ok = mem_now[j] + pod.mem_request <= cand.mem_capacity
                ok = distinct and cpu_ok and mem_ok and (not cand.suspended)
                if ok:
                    dst_aff = affinity_to(pod.id, j, state, graph)
                    dst_cpu_after = cpu_now[j] + pod.cpu_request
                    dst_power_before = node_power(cand, cpu_now[j])
                    dst_power_after = node_power(cand, dst_cpu_after)
                    dst_increase = dst_power_after - dst_power_before
                    energy_gain = src_reduction - dst_increase
                    affinity_gain = dst_aff - src_aff
                    active_gain = 0.0
                    if cpu_now[j] > 0:
                        active_gain = 50.0
                    dst_threshold = cand.cpu_capacity * 9 // 10
                    dst_over = dst_cpu_after - dst_threshold
                    over_pen = 0.0
                    if dst_over > 0:
                        over_pen = float(dst_over) * 100.0
                    total_gain = energy_gain * 3.0 + affinity_gain * 8.0 + active_gain - over_pen
                    if total_gain > best_gain:
                        best_gain = total_gain
                        best = j
            if best >= 0 and best_gain > 1.0:
                out.append(move_pod(pod.id, best))
                new_cpu: list[int] = []
                new_mem: list[int] = []
                for k in range(n_nodes):
                    cv = cpu_now[k]
                    mv = mem_now[k]
                    if k == src_id:
                        cv = cv - pod.cpu_request
                        mv = mv - pod.mem_request
                    if k == best:
                        cv = cv + pod.cpu_request
                        mv = mv + pod.mem_request
                    new_cpu.append(cv)
                    new_mem.append(mv)
                cpu_now = new_cpu
                mem_now = new_mem
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
